answer: Picture agent identities as a frozen tundra: if one hidden inference pipeline drives them all, their reply timings and latency fingerprints drift in lockstep. Fire an independent challenge at every identity at the same instant under a tight deadline. A shared backend must serialize, so its concurrent answers correlate; truly separate agents stay uncorrelated. Masks that share one mind ring hollow here. To beat it, an attacker must buy real ferrous-grade compute, a separate accelerator per identity answering live, not cheap forks of one brain. That per-mask hardware floor is the sybil tax.
